test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Simplify the expression (s²+t²+2 s t-u²)/(s²-t²-2 t u-u²) provided (s + t + u) ≠ 0.
solution:
**Formula used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

a² - b² = (a + b) (a - b)

**Calculation:**

(s²+t²+2 s t-u²)/(s²-t²-2 t u-u²)
